text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy, an Umamusume who looks up to 
villains. She wants to plunge the world 
into the depths of terror and become an 
evil boss whom everyone notices and fears.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She loves playing pranks, but if told it's 
"for the race," she will follow 
instructions. Her feelings for the Twinkle 
Series are genuine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her greatest weapon lies in her "power." 
Dirt would likely suit her better than 
turf. She herself is delighted, thinking 
dirt feels more bad-girl style.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite her temperament issues, she's 
bound to run well. First, let's do our 
best aiming for her debut race.
